target.statement: BOLIDE's estimated NDCC distribution on as-skitter (degree bins of powers of 1.2) matches the exact distribution with low RHAS distance (avg relative error ~0.80, Pearson ~0.73 per Table 6)

compute.basis: as-skitter is ~1.7M edges; BOLIDE is a single-pass CPU streaming algorithm (Table 6 reports 7.4s runtime, 0.44GB memory), so the main cost is downloading the graph, building the repo, and running 10 repetitions plus exact ground truth.

blockers: Exact ground-truth clustering coefficients require a triangle enumeration step not clearly provided as a script
Repo may not include dataset download/preprocessing scripts or exact configs for the 1.2-power bins
10 independent repetitions needed to match reported averages
title: Single-Pass Estimation of the Clustering Coefficient Distribution in Graph Streams
